answer: Anchor each identity to one verified bank account, not to an email anyone can mint. The agent links an account, the bank confirms a micro-deposit only the holder can see, and peers check that no second identity claims the same account. An account closed for fraud revokes the identity at once. Forging ten thousand agents means opening ten thousand real bank accounts under ten thousand KYC identities, costing $2 million in minimum balances plus 120,000 hours of paperwork. A tide lifts every boat the same way, but a beacon on a ridge marks one fixed point that cannot be faked twice.
